cases.title: A pit placed today (P8) takes its number's place in the Pit Schedule (P7, P8, P9, P10, then C1), not the bottom of the list
cases.plan_item: UX-SCHED-06 Pit Schedule natural order, a newly placed pit and P before the other groups (daily card D21 assertions 1 and 2, and 3 as far as this drawing allows)

not_automated: The LPD, OG and CP groups are not in this drawing and the P1A / SPS refinement is switched off (card D21 assertion 4): not tested.
